styleReference: User-attached white Metalwood Studio poster, background material only; text and frame excluded.

landscape.prompt: Edit the generated wide white background (the image with coarse cyan/red/black dragged PAINT at both sides) using the user's attached Metalwood Studio poster as the MATERIAL/STYLE reference, not as text to reproduce. Change ONLY the pigment texture and the composition density. Keep landscape aspect ratio, near-white paper, quiet central area for a game planet, no lettering and no frame. The current generated image is far too rough, dry-brush grunge and heavy black paint. Remove ALL brush scratches, drips, splatters, coarse distressed paint edges and large black slabs. Match the poster's SOFT overexposed analog chromatic distortion: narrow and medium-width irregular vertical translucent pigment fields with organic oval white holes and smooth molten saturated red/yellow forms inside milky turquoise, mint, lavender and sparse charcoal. Edges should dissolve into the white with very fine high-resolution SCREENPRINT DOTS and soft chromatic fringes, like a deliberately blurred and halftone-printed photograph, NOT painted brushstrokes. White accounts for at least 80 percent; colours appear as airy broken interrupted vertical islands at different heights, not full-height painted walls. Avoid overly symmetrical columns; retain one somewhat fuller blue/mint pigment island at left-middle and a few narrower red/lemon/cyan islands at right. Thin ghosts near centre. Elegant, delicate, overexposed, experimental print-poster material precisely like the attached reference's background art. No sky blue solid field, no stickers, no cutout shapes, no swooshes, no rings, no text, no border, no people, no game objects. One cohesive edge-to-edge white art surface. High resolution, landscape 3:2.

portrait.prompt: Create a PORTRAIT mobile-screen edition of this exact abstract background artwork. Keep its subtle white paper, soft fine halftone print texture, airy overexposed cyan/mint/lavender fields, small molten red/yellow/charcoal pigment islands and organic oval white voids. Recompose into a tall 2:3 portrait format; do not simply stretch the landscape picture. Keep 75-80% white negative space. Irregular broken vertical pigment masses of varying widths appear near the sides at different heights, with pale delicate ghost traces approaching the middle. Preserve a broad quiet white central area where a game planet will be placed and calm white space near the top for controls. The whole image must feel like one coherent refined experimental screen-printed surface, not separate stickers or repetitive lines. Preserve the gentle edges and very fine dots of the input. No rough brush marks, grunge splatters, full-height solid paint walls, ring outlines, cutout polygons, text, letters, border, logo, people, fish, planet or UI. Deliver only the finished portrait background art.

delivery: Selected generated PNGs exported to JPEG quality 92, no resampling. Original generation files retained outside the project; application imports only these project-local JPEGs.
